name: AeroQuote
category: AOG support: parts, rotables and technicians
summary: An AOG quoting agent for small MRO and parts shops. Forward an RFQ email and it parses the parts, sends supplier RFQs in parallel, validates FAA 8130-3 certs against the PO and returns a priced quote, in under five minutes according to the company. Every quote waits in your dashboard for approval before it goes to the customer.
paragraphs: An AOG quoting agent for small MRO and parts shops. Forward an RFQ email and it parses the parts, sends supplier RFQs in parallel, validates FAA 8130-3 certs against the PO and returns a priced quote, in under five minutes according to the company. Every quote waits in your dashboard for approval before it goes to the customer.
whyItMatters: AeroQuote puts a lost AOG bid at $5K to $50K in revenue, and the 3 am requests are the ones most shops miss. If you quote 20 to 200 RFQs a month by spreadsheet and email, the free first 20 quotes are a cheap test against your current response time.
pricing: $299 per month plus $2 per quote sent; first 20 quotes free
